verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is a cloud-backed coding agent with accounts, plans and usage metering, so data residency is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack does not document any region or residency selection. The llms.txt probe mentions a data-handling policy but gives none of its content. Bring-your-own OpenAI-compatible models (docs-8) only lets users choose which inference endpoint to use; it does not document where ByteAsk stores user data.
